body:
Vanilla BedWars

Vanilla BedWars is a clean and lightweight resource pack designed specifically for BedWars players who prefer the classic Minecraft look. The pack keeps the familiar vanilla style while introducing subtle improvements that enhance visibility, consistency, and overall gameplay.

Features
Clean vanilla-inspired 16x textures
Improved item and weapon visuals
Enhanced clarity for competitive gameplay
Lightweight and performance-friendly
Consistent design that stays true to Minecraft's original aesthetic
Perfect for BedWars, SkyWars, Duels, and Survival
Recommended For
Players who enjoy the default Minecraft style
BedWars and SkyWars enthusiasts
PvP players looking for a clean and distraction-free experience
Anyone wanting better visuals without straying far from vanilla
Compatibility
Minecraft Java Edition
16x Resolution
Designed for modern Minecraft versions

Created by DerBambus

Vanilla BedWars focuses on preserving the original Minecraft atmosphere while providing a smoother and cleaner experience for competitive gameplay.
